title: Ultra Gooey French Cheese Croquettes
description: A peppery and gooey French dish from Brittany, perfect for a post-workout snack, featuring tamarind paste and deep-fried to a crispy golden brown, this recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded gruyere and emmental cheese.
Add the tamarind paste, melted butter, and black pepper to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and set aside.
Add the flour to the cheese mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Using your hands, shape the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Dip each ball into the whisked eggs, coating completely, then roll in the panko breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully place the coated cheese balls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the croquettes from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the ultra gooey French cheese croquettes hot and enjoy.
